title: supported integral derived unit
statement: Let i:D→T be a closed immersion, n>0 and A a finite commutative ring killed by n. The normalized integral generator i_*Z_D→forget(i_*A_D) has the unbounded DerivedUnit property [def-sp-exact-functor-derived-unit, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. No flatness of A over Z/n is assumed.

proof.text: Apply scalarUniversal_derivedUnit to each SupportedDerivedScalarUnit hypothesis. This API theorem gives the raw unbounded exact-functor unit without unfolding concrete derived localization data, and preserves the current ordinary supported-scalar definition verbatim.

Apply the residue-quotient unit theorem to the supported integer/residue exact sequence. The existing supported-constant coefficient theorem supplies its normalized derived unit from ULift(Z/n) to A. Compose the two Hom bijections, using the derived composition/single coherence. The constant-sections adjunction and normalization on generators identify the composed ordinary map with the integral generator. Transport across the identity isomorphism between composite and direct coefficient forgetting.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_integral_derived_unit
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (n : A) = 0)
    {D : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget A T).DerivedUnit
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj (supportedIntegralConstant D))
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (supportedIntegralGenerator A i)
